question: Should this defense-in-depth guard merge without a production-client baseline that reproduces overlap beyond the existing 15-second request timeout?
rationale: Source inspection establishes that current main already bounds individual probes, but it does not establish whether a realistic complete sweep can still cross the 120-second interval; accepting that gap is a maintainer proof standard decision.

options.title: Require equivalent baseline proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until current main and the branch are compared through the real manager and REST client under a realistic sweep exceeding 120 seconds.

options.title: Accept defense in depth
options.body: Merge the guard as preventive hardening despite the missing production-contract reproduction, while explicitly accepting the unverified premise and duplicated timeout.

recommendation.title: Require equivalent baseline proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until current main and the branch are compared through the real manager and REST client under a realistic sweep exceeding 120 seconds.
